newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market standstill-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market standstill-USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

No Sales reported on slaughter steers or heifers; 97,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 60 loads or 2,000 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 15,600 formulated and 1,900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.

The last established market was 69.00 on Wednesday morning. Limited bidding today is at 67.00-68.00 with asking prices 69.00-70.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
